sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: 8c829d9b38b8's and 364704f371dd's Linux hollows refused because the baseline computes missing = declared - teeth_green and drops not_run_teeth, so a tooth this host cannot run reads as red at HEAD.

sub_problems.fills: D2: the unread teeth ride the seal as evidence['hollow_anchor'][tid]['not_run'] = {proof_rel: [teeth]}, written by cli.py only when there are any (the way ce92eb562cf9's revert_mode rides the anchor), beside evidence['hollow'] and never inside the per-file reading clearance.hollow_lacks reads. measure() returns them as finding['hollow_not_run']. Amended 2026-11-23 at build: the seal write lives in cli.py, not hollow.py, so a new evidence key would have needed validation_store too.
